svg.title: Customer recovery and operations handoff have different finish lines
svg.desc: An alarm returning to OK is a clue, not a booking receipt. Customer recovery in this local model requires two fresh distinct successful booking checks and a completion record for every stipulated accepted request. Only after that can the operations handoff be complete with a named owner, a current OK alarm and acknowledged delivery for each distinct alert transition. Retry attempts of one transition share its identity; a later transition needs its own delivery. This is a fictional local decision model, not AWS or human notification evidence.
svg.text: A green alarm does not finish an accepted booking.
Useful signal about one condition; not a customer receipt.
Two fresh, distinct successful booking checks.
Every stipulated accepted booking has a completion record.
Named owner, current OK alarm, delivery for each transition.
Same transition: retries share an ID; a later one is new.
A delivery acknowledgment does not prove a person read it.
Fictional local model; no AWS or human notification tested.
